articles.title: A reprieve from rising oil prices helps steady the US stock and bond markets
articles.description: A cooldown in oil prices is helping to release some of the pressure that’s built up on Wall Street, and U.S. stocks are ticking higher. The S&P 500 rose 0.3% Friday, coming off a three-day losing streak marked by big swings caused by rising yields in the bond market. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 179 points, and the Nasdaq composite climbed 0.4%. The fall for oil prices helped to steady the bond market, where rising yields have rattled financial markets worldwide. The 10-year Treasury yield held at 5.18% after nearing its highest level since 2007 the day before.
